note: Place du Village, the start of the whole village (painterly storybook, neutral daylight). Petite École (B02) on the left exactly as its own exterior: white house, giant open book on the roof (its name is written on the book pages), two round-window dormers, round bell turret with a cone roof, five shuttered windows (teal, red, green, blue, purple) and SIX arched ground-floor doors (yellow, teal, blue, purple, peach, green), one per ground-floor room. Fontaine des Salutations (B01) front centre exactly as its exterior: low stone wall with open wrought-iron gates, round basin with the top-hat fountain and two stone hands, ivy-covered stone arch with the name board, hedges, roses and lavender. Tour de l'Horloge (B03) centre back and Atelier des Couleurs (B04, palette cottage) right, unchanged. Street mouths: glass arcade (Passage des Objets Trouvés) far left, cherry-blossom lane (Chemin des Gestes) between the school and the tower, bunting street (Rue de l'Accueil) behind the palette cottage, cobbled lane at the far right to the Cafés quarter (S04).
